Visit the site regularly and apply directly to each job you’re interested in. Every posting includes specific application instructions.

We hire throughout the year, so keep checking for updates! Most hiring occurs during specific seasons.

Typical Library Hiring Cycles:

  • Spring semester positions: Nov–Dec
  • Summer & Fall positions: Mar–Apr
  • Additional Fall positions: Jul–Aug

Library HR does not accept or retain resumes.

  • How to Apply
    • Available Undergraduate University Library positions are updated regularly in the “Current Openings” section above.
      • If you are interested in applying to a position listed in the “Current Openings” section, please follow the instructions at the end of each posting.
      • If you have questions about applying to a specific position listed above, please reach out to the contact listed in the applicable posting.
    • You may contact University Library Unit Supervisors to express your interest in employment with their Unit.
    • If you have general questions, you may email Library HR’s Hourly Employment Coordinator, Grace Flavin at: gflavin@illinois.edu.
